floorPlans.note: All 132 residence drawings and eight community or phase diagrams are retained as complete original spreads across Dana, Lareen, Laura, Sedra, Layan and Dalia. Areas describe each whole home, including the shown roof or pump-room components where applicable. Repeated totals on separate levels are counted once. Community boundaries differ between earlier and Dalia brochure revisions. The reviewed Dalia drawing pack contains two- to four-bedroom homes. Its FAQ mentions five bedrooms and different area endpoints, which remain unresolved. The images and fit-out concepts are proposed and source revisions require confirmation.

review.imagery: Root visually reviewed all 55 extracted Dalia brochure candidates and five observed official website images. Selected 34 project concept renders. Generic lifestyle people, logo sheets, maps, drawing resources and duplicate crops were excluded from the gallery. Shared community amenities and unassigned interior concepts retain their scope. No completed photography or exact interior unit is inferred.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed all 132 complete original residence spreads and all 132 visible numeric panels across six PDFs. Twenty-two Dana, twenty-two Lareen, twenty-four Laura, twenty-four Sedra, twenty-four Layan and sixteen Dalia drawings are preserved. Root reviewed eight selected community or phase maps. Whole-home totals and multi-level repeats remain separate from floor components. Dalia FAQ and revision conflicts remain explicit.
review.location: Root reviewed the original regional panels and selected complete Dalia physical spread 15. The visible 15-minute Sharjah and 20-minute Dubai airport groups take precedence over misordered extracted text. All nine destinations retain community-estimate scope. No exact entrance or distance was invented.
review.provenance: Six original official PDF receipts, current official HTML and observed website image receipts are dated 7 November 2026 and retain URLs, byte counts and SHA256. Original masters and full drawing notices are preserved. Ordinary public downloads only. Protected canonical identity and researched text remain intact.

unavailable: Exact entrance coordinates, kilometre journeys and live travel times are unavailable. Dalia FAQ bedroom/area differences and community master-plan revision boundaries remain unresolved. Interiors are shared brochure concepts without an identified contracted unit.
